skill.summary: Plan and execute a migration from Amazon to Shopify DTC or build a dual-channel strategy to reduce platform dependency. Triggers: amazon to shopify, migrate...

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release: Provides Amazon to Shopify migration planning and dual-channel strategy support.

- Helps assess migration vs dual-channel approaches for Amazon sellers.
- Offers DTC brand-building guidance and Shopify store setup essentials.
- Includes actionable plans for traffic acquisition and customer data ownership.
- Details legal methods for building an email list from Amazon customers.
- Supplies a 90-day migration roadmap for a smooth, profitable transition.
